classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the explicitly common base and given parallel-line height, then directly apply the triangle-area formula to each.

content.prompt: Write down the area of each of the triangles with base AB.

spec.description: Complete actual source givens, perpendicular heights/equality families and mathematical shaded regions retained. Native editable black10pt figure, no derived dimensions.

answer.worked: C, D and E lie on the same line parallel to AB, so all three triangles have the same perpendicular height 7 cm and base 8 cm. $$A_{ABC}=A_{ABD}=A_{ABE}=\tfrac12(8)(7)=28\text{ cm}^2.$$
